title: Role of the Church in Education and Health
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner appraises the church's contribution to education and health (schools, colleges, hospitals, clinics, children's homes), identifies barriers to mission work today (poverty, distance, insecurity, few workers, language, disunity) and recommends solutions.

floor.prerequisite: Knows that the Bible inspires Christian service.
floor.question: Name a service inspired by the Bible.

representations: names of local mission hospitals and schools
contexts: a mission hospital in a rural area
missionaries in a dry northern county

board.do: Draw two columns: barrier and solution.
Wait for the learner to suggest one.

misconceptions.ask: What did the Church start in Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: List local schools and hospitals with church names (mission hospitals, church-sponsored schools).

misconceptions.ask: Which is a barrier to mission work?
misconceptions.repair: Explain barrier as something that blocks; list poverty, distance, insecurity, few workers, language.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a way to answer the barriers?
misconceptions.repair: Match each barrier with a solution: training, partnerships, funding, translation, security.

listen_for: No, that was only long ago
misconceptions.ask: Does the church still contribute to education and health in Kenya today?
misconceptions.repair: Find a church-sponsored school or mission hospital near the school today.

checks.question: Name a contribution of the church to health.
Name a barrier to mission work today.
